props.name: items
props.description: One event per entry (a title, or a title with a date and a description), or a count.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.

props.name: title
props.description: Drawn in place of the title bar.

props.name: date
props.description: Drawn in place of the first line bar.

props.name: description
props.description: Drawn in place of the second line bar.
